info.headline: Mahanadi delta: flooding expected at a Naraj flow of 23,940 m3/s
info.description: MAHANADI DELTA - EXPECTED FLOODING FOR A NARAJ FLOW OF 23,940 m3/s (8.5 lakh cusec), lead time 24 h (flow = highest daily flow over 5 days at Naraj, the measure the atlas is fitted on; method: analog maps on river flow and 20 mm of 7-day rain; similar past passes: 20190918, 20190919, 20230811, 20230813, 20260907, 20260909, 20261003) Expected flooded land: 25 km2 People living on that land: 5,021 Settlements with at least 10 % of people on flooded land: 0 Main roads under water: 0.8 km; named sections: Left Puri Main Canal Road 0.4 km Source: Sentinel-1 flood atlas 2017-2026 + GloFAS discharge (IIT Bombay IDP prototype). Not an official warning.
info.instruction: Follow the district administration; keep off flooded roads.
